headline: Do you ever eat 4 points and do a transfer without a FT?
body: This is my first year playing, having a blast! My defense is in bad shape and I'd like to pick up Silva, but essentially he would have to outscore De Cuyper or Cala by 4 to break even. Unless I don't have any healthy players, I think it is better to not eat 4 points and wait for next week. So the question is how often do you eat 4 points? I can't imagine eating 8 or even 12 like a friend of mine did earlier this year.   submitted by   /u/FBGCorp [link]   [comments]
